text: In a temple tucked under a banyan tree lives a jolly old god who's as sweet as can be with a trunk so long in his spread wide. It's conia with a sweet tooth high. He much a tasty treat stuffed with jaggery and coconut. Oh so sweet loud as round as the moon in a monsoon June. He hums a little tune under the silver spoon. Oh dear, oh dear, says he with a grin. I can't stop beating. Where do I begin? His bellies quiet round, his joy quite infectious. The sweets make him boundlessly zealous. From village, they know his taste. Prepare the sweets. No time to waste.
